versions.changelog:
Initial release of Greek-language document OCR with local Tesseract processing:

- Provides advanced OCR for Greek invoices, receipts, government forms, and handwritten documents.
- All processing is local; no cloud OCR APIs required.
- Includes extensive OpenClaw command set for extraction, validation, classification, and export to accounting systems (QuickBooks, Xero).
- Optimized for Greek character recognition, business terminology, and production-grade accuracy.
- Supports quality control, manual review, and export of structured data for seamless accounting workflow integration.
